brief.name: Skill Swap
brief.summary: A private team workspace for reusable AI skills and plugins. Individual contributions become shared capability through a clear library, independent review and approved releases. The promise is: Your team's know-how, ready to use. The visual identity is warm and editorial. The dimensional logo MUST be built from layered heavyweight paper or card, with broad geometric pieces, controlled folds, substantial thickness, visible edges and restrained fiber texture. Explore three distinct territories: joined modules, a folded shared object, and parts framing an open shared space.
brief.audience: Teammates with mixed technical confidence, including newcomers discovering and using AI skills; Builders and trusted approvers maintain the shared library.
brief.intended_appearance: Layered matte paper in forest green and pale sage, soft restrained shadows, crisp cut edges.
avoid: Any non-paper material including ceramic, porcelain, metal, rubber, glass, wax or clay
A badge, medallion, backing disc or frame
Generic AI sparkles, chain links or recycling arrows
Slack hashtag or Dropbox diamond-box topology
Cohere cell cluster and Miro chevrons
Fine text or hairline geometry inside the symbol
Confusing peer-to-peer skill barter with a team AI skills library

concept.metaphor: An open folio built from two broad folded paper panels presents a central spine. A team's working knowledge is open and ready to use; keep the mark simple and substantial.
concept.treatment: The mark itself as a solid object with depth and softly beveled edges, standing free with no backing.
concept.material: Heavy matte paper or card with a fine fiber texture.

state.intended_appearance: Layered matte paper in forest green and pale sage, soft restrained shadows, crisp cut edges.

symbol.instructions: Does `candidate` visibly express the motif described in `concept` for `brief`?

criteria.true: The described symbolic relationship is visible in the actual shapes and fits the brand direction.
criteria.false: The symbolic relationship is absent, contradicted or depends only on the written explanation.

criteria.true: Gloss, reflection strength, highlight contrast and edge roundness suit the stated finish, whether restrained or glossy.
criteria.false: The visible finish contradicts the stated direction, even if it is competently executed in another style.

brand_specificity.instructions: Does `candidate` contain a developed visual idea specific to the purpose or identity in `brief`?

criteria.true: Authored relationships, negative space, letterform integration or distinctive construction connect this mark to the brand beyond its broad category.
criteria.false: A stock category icon or arrangement of generic primitives could be reassigned to many brands without meaningful change; the explanation supplies the specificity.

meaningful_synthesis.instructions: Do the visible shape relationships in `candidate` express the brand promise in `brief`?

criteria.true: The actual construction communicates a purposeful relationship, action or visual idea grounded in the brand promise, with a coherent shared core motif.
criteria.false: The shapes merely illustrate a category object or sit together decoratively while the claimed brand relationship remains in the prose.

constraint_fidelity.instructions: Does `candidate` honor the explicit direction and avoid-list in `brief`?

criteria.true: The visible design follows the actual user constraints, including required materials, topology and identity.
criteria.false: The design contradicts a stated user constraint, despite being attractive or competently rendered.

communicative_clarity.instructions: Can the intended audience in `brief` read the core visual idea in `candidate` without the concept explanation?

criteria.true: The intended relationship is perceptible from the mark itself and supports the brand's purpose.
criteria.false: A viewer needs the written concept explanation to discover the claimed meaning, or reads a conflicting idea.

small_flat.instructions: Does `flat_32px` preserve the intended core motif shown in `candidate`?

criteria.true: The flat master preserves a clear, recognizable shared core at 32 px. Secondary hero lettering and ornament need not be readable here.
criteria.false: The shared core collapses, merges or becomes a different mark at 32 px.

small_hero.instructions: Does `hero_32px` retain the core motif's identity from `candidate`?

criteria.true: The primary silhouette and core relationship remain recognizable at 32 px; secondary lettering and hero ornament may disappear.
criteria.false: The core motif becomes unreadable or loses its identity at 32 px.
